impact: Still unfixed: T-021 criterion 4 unconditionally demands a Gatekeeper-passing cask while T-016 NO-GO — an explicitly allowed outcome — makes that impossible (cask downloads are quarantined; no notarization means Gatekeeper blocks first launch). Re-spec: criterion 4 conditional on the recorded T-016 outcome — GO: notarized cask verified on a clean machine (online minimum, offline recorded); NO-GO: cask explicitly descoped with named reopening triggers, or an npm-wrapping formula validated by clean-machine install + first run instead. Also refresh T-021 open question 5: membership is paid per N-002; the remaining owner question is the signing-identity name (personal vs organization) versus the no-personal-attribution rule.
resolution: Fixed by the v0.2/v0.3 ticket re-spec applied 2026-08-02: T-021's cask criterion is conditional on T-016's outcome, with the NO-GO alternative spelled out. The full verified requirements record is preserved in this issue's impact field.
title: T-021 is unsatisfiable when T-016 returns an allowed NO-GO: its cask criterion is unconditional
